conflicts.description: The showcase's only captured AI Tutor mobile frame depicts the CONTEXTUAL invocation (header subtitle "Lesson 15 context", a more_vert menu instead of a back arrow, lines 2202-2206) launched from Course Player — not the tab-root variant reached by tapping the AI Tutor bottom-nav item directly. This frame renders NO bottom-nav row at all (788px height fully consumed by header + chat thread + composer, lines 2199-2229). ux/MOBILE_UX.md § 10 describes AI Tutor as a "Full-screen tab," and § 1's persistence rule does not list AI Tutor among the screens that hide the nav — implying the tab-root variant SHOULD show it, but no showcase evidence directly confirms that for AI Tutor's own frame (only Home/Explore/My Learning's frames show the nav row explicitly).
conflicts.resolution: Not resolved by asserting a specific answer — disclosed as inferred, not shown. This spec assumes the tab-root variant keeps the bottom nav visible (consistent with § 1's rule that only Course Player/Quiz hide it) while the contextual-from-Course-Player variant reasonably hides it (since Course Player itself already hides the nav, and this is effectively still "inside" that focused-learning context) — both readings are consistent with rank-1 text, neither is showcase-pixel-verified for this specific screen.

layout.structure: single scrolling column: header (avatar/icon badge + "AI Tutor" title + contextual subtitle + more_vert or back) -> chat thread (scrolling) -> quick-action row (horizontally scrollable, pinned above input) -> pill-shaped composer + circular send button
layout.adaptation: full-screen on mobile (no persistent Sidebar beside it, unlike Web's full-height panel with Sidebar still visible per ai-tutor.json)

content: circular icon badge (secondary.container background, auto_awesome icon, lines 2203) + "AI Tutor" title + contextual subtitle ("Lesson 15 context") + more_vert trigger (lines 2202-2206)

AITutorBubble messages — AI bubble on surface.variant with bottom-start-reduced corner (border-radius "16px 16px 16px 8px", line 2208), Student bubble on brand.primaryContainer with bottom-end-reduced corner (border-radius "16px 16px 8px 16px", line 2209) — an exact match to shared/components.json#/aiTutor/bubble's tailCorner rule; "thinking" indeterminate 3-dot indicator shown inline as its own bubble-shaped row when AI is composing (lines 2211-2217)

horizontally scrollable pill chips (lines 2220-2224): showcase shows 3 of the 5 locked defaultActions visible in the compact frame ("Give me an example", "Quiz me", "What next?" — an abbreviation of "What should I learn next?" for space, not a 4th/different action) — all 5 from shared/components.json#/aiTutor/quickAction/defaultActions still apply, this frame just can't show all 5 in 340px width

pill-shaped composer (radius.full, placeholder "Ask anything…") + circular icon send button (lines 2225-2228) — same pill/circular-send treatment ai-tutor.json's D52 fix already brought to Web, confirming Web's D52 correction was actually restoring parity with this pre-existing mobile mockup, not inventing a new pattern
